description: An upload_id and a signed url for a PNG or JPEG up to 10 MB, from a local `path` (local server only) or a public https `url` (up to 20 seconds and 3 redirects). The url is signed for 24 hours; the upload_id lasts 365 days. Set aspect_ratio to match the picture. Remote server and a file on disk: create_upload. Free; 20 uploads per day, at most 30 url downloads per hour.
name: upload_image
title: Upload an image
